'''Ishel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] who served aboard the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] leader [[Brigadier]] [[Jarrow Rusher]]'s flagship [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. Following the [[Battle of Gazzari]], the ''Diligence'' left [[Gazzari]] with 1,700 student passengers and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]]. During the journey to [[Byllura]], Rusher asked Ishel if he was able to get to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, the Mon Calamari was unable to find any reliable [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] to Republic Space due to the deactivation of the [[Communications relay/Legends|hyperspace relays]] and the ''Diligence'' was forced to travel to Byllura. There, Kerra and Rusher played a pivotal role in overthrowing the [[Dyarchy]], a local Sith regime. He then presumably went on to participate in the [[Battle of Byllura]] and the [[Siege of Calimondretta]].
